title: History, Categories, and Approaches to AI
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in History, Categories, and Approaches to AI and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 2: History, Categories, and Approaches to AI. It lists 7 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 2 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 7 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. AI contains multiple traditions and capability labels. Compare systems by what they do, how they work, and the evidence available—not by hype. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
